verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents server-side/Node.js usage and a NullEngine specifically designed for headless rendering without a GPU/DOM, which supports CI and automation scenarios. However, there's no first-party CI pipeline example, no dedicated CLI, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of headless CI usage in the community evidence. Missing for 10: concrete CI workflow examples (GitHub Actions/Docker), independent confirmation of headless NullEngine use in production CI, and details on automated visual/regression testing setups.
